svg.title: Freelingo speech bubble
svg.desc: Original work for Freelingo (AGPL-3.0). The S034 bubble an avatar speaks from, built as the two-layer primitive scope/10 measured across this UI: an outer box carrying the border colour and an inner face inset from it, rather than one box with a stroke. Radius 12 matches the measured card token; the tail points left, at the avatar.
